title: PET bottle 500 ml
detail: PET bottle 500 ml: a 500 ml PET water bottle with a soft, rounded petaloid base and a screw cap (separate body). The outline with its spline shoulder is revolved and shelled to a 0.35 mm tube; the base is two lofts (the outer solid and the cavity one wall inside it) through 14 round sections, each a closed loop of tangent arcs: five fat feet joined by five small valley ribs, curling under like the 9 mm base corner and running out vertical into the cylinder, with a rounded push-up centre. No fillet is used and no edge of the base is sharp. CAP=1 adds the cap and THREAD=1 gives the neck a real helical thread (28 mm finish: 25.5 mm root, 27.6 mm crest, 2.7 mm pitch, 2 turns, swept on a helix) and the cap the matching internal thread with 0.15 mm flank clearance, plus 30 grip ribs (GRIP). Variables: WALL, FEET (3 to 7), CAP, THREAD, PITCH, TURNS, CLR, GRIP; THREAD=0 keeps the light plain neck and cap
